articles.title: EasyA hits $1.1 billion valuation, targets 2027 public listing and tokenized shares
articles.snippet: The blockchain and AI developer platform has completed two years of audits and wants its shares available onchain from the first day of trading.

articles.title: Qivalis wins Dutch e-money license for euro stablecoin
articles.snippet: Qivalis said the Electronic Money Institution authorization enables it to launch a euro-denominated stablecoin, with issuance planned for the coming months, subject to additional MiCA requirements.

articles.title: Strive reports $208M in warrant exercises as Bitcoin holdings jump 11%
articles.snippet: Strive is now the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder, with 32,773 BTC, as it continues to expand its treasury through equity financing.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Opens Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading to Wealthy UAE Clients
articles.snippet: The British bank won Dubai regulatory approval to let affluent clients buy BTC and ETH straight from their bank accounts, with custody and settlement kept in-house.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Will Hold Ripple's Stablecoin in Dubai—And Let Clients Trade With It Without Moving It
articles.snippet: The bank's Dubai branch now offers custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and plans a link with LMAX that lets institutions post it as trading collateral while the coins stay put.
